name: Raene's Cleansing
summary: This step in the long-running Ashenvale investigation sees Dartol's Rod of Transformation fully restored. Entrusted with the completed artifact by the dryad Shael'dryn, you return to Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar to report success and honor the memory of the fallen scout Teronis.

sections.title: The Rod Restored
sections.body: After scouring the corrupted reaches of Ashenvale for components and ancient gem fragments, the relic known as Dartol's Rod of Transformation has finally been reforged. Entrusted to the dryad Shael'dryn near Iris Lake, its magical properties were cleansed and renewed. With the craftsmanship complete, she directs you back across the forest roads to Astranaar to present the artifact to Raene Wolfrunner.

sections.title: Honoring Teronis
sections.body: The entire endeavor began as an expedition led by Teronis, a longtime friend of Raene who sought Dartol's rod in the hope of slowing the furbolg attacks on his people. Teronis was found dead atop the island in Lake Falathim, cut down by the murlocs who had taken the gem he sought, before he could see his task fulfilled. Returning the restored rod to Raene Wolfrunner marks a bittersweet victory, ensuring his dangerous sacrifice was not in vain.

faq.q: What is Dartol's Rod of Transformation?
faq.answer: It is the magical rod created by Dartol, a deceased evil wizard. Once restored, it can aid Raene's investigation of the furbolg attacks in Ashenvale.

Teronis was a young night elf sentinel tasked by Raene Wolfrunner to locate components of ancient magic in Ashenvale. He was found dead atop the island in Lake Falathim, cut down by the murlocs who had taken the gem he sought, leaving the completion of his vital mission to passing Alliance travelers.

Raene Wolfrunner is an experienced night elf sentinel commander stationed in the heart of Astranaar. She oversees the defense of central Ashenvale against invading demonic taint, hostile satyrs, and local beast corruptions.

Shael'dryn is a dryad residing quietly near the moonwell east of Iris Lake. Her deep knowledge of the forest and its ancient relics allows her to purify corrupted relics and restore ancient tools of power.

faq.q: Where does this quest take place?
faq.answer: This errand takes you from the tranquil banks of Iris Lake in central Ashenvale back west along the main trails into Astranaar, the primary Alliance hub of the zone.

faq.q: What happens after presenting the rod to Raene?
faq.answer: Raene expresses deep relief and pride that Teronis's final mission succeeded. However, the cleansing of Ashenvale is far from over, and she immediately looks for ways to employ the rod's power against the woodland's persistent corruption.

angles.text: Carrying Teronis's legacy brings closure to Astranaar, proving that fallen kin will not be forgotten amid the rising threats to Kalimdor's sacred groves.
Astranaar stands as the Alliance's anchor in Ashenvale; assisting Raene Wolfrunner directly cements your standing among the reclusive Sentinels.
